description: Sets or removes the server's environment variables; the live version restarts with them. secret: true for keys and passwords (kept in Ploa's vault and Google's Secret Manager, never shown again); plain values show. Never put a secret the person hasn't given you; ask them to set it on the server's page instead. DATABASE_URL is set by Ploa.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

name: ploa_server_env
title: The server's environment variables
